title: PepLab Bench: reusable source-model-selector peptide replay
description: Portable integration contracts and saved-result explorer accompanying a complete 30,200-episode development replay on 160 archived HLA-A*02:01 nine-mers. Original numerical functions are AST-preserved; portable adapters are new and contract-tested. No new independent biological validation. No pretrained weights or third-party runtime binaries bundled.
